response.sql: WITH regional_stats AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) as transaction_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) as overall_average FROM regional_stats) SELECT rs.region, rs.avg_signed_amount, rs.transaction_count, rs.avg_signed_amount / oa.overall_average as ratio FROM regional_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE oa.overall_average IS NOT NULL
